t: 阿瓦尔和斯拉夫军队离开对君士坦丁堡的包围.
te: The Avar and Slav armies leave the siege of Constantinople.
dz: 阿瓦尔和斯拉夫军队离开对君士坦丁堡的包围.
de: The Avar and Slav armies leave the siege of Constantinople.

t: 沙赫尔巴拉斯将军手下的萨萨尼德军队征服了泽诺比亚镇.
te: Sassanid troops under general Shahrbaraz conquer the town of Zenobia.
dz: 拜占庭-撒南战争 602–628:沙赫尔巴拉斯将军手下的萨萨尼德军队征服了泽诺比亚镇.
de: Byzantine–Sasanian War of 602–628: Sassanid troops under general Shahrbaraz conquer the town of Zenobia.

dz: 罗曼皇帝马约里安被法师里西默逮捕并作证后被斩首于意大利西北部伊里亚河附近.
de: Roman Emperor Majorian is beheaded near the river Iria in north-west Italy following his arrest and deposition by the magister militum Ricimer.
